messages:
maria: hey team — trying to pull up EU model health + service overview dashboards for a sync in 15m but the grafana link in the runbook gives me a 403. anyone know the shortlink or the RBAC group I need? need view access to: Service Overview (all regions), Model Health (eu-west), and Region Health (apac). thanks!

leo: hi @maria — shortlinks (copied from current grafana):
Service Overview: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/xy12/service-overview?orgId=1
Model Health (eu-west): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ab34/model-health-eu
Region Health (apac): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/cd56/region-health-apac

403 usually means you need the `observability:view` permission in the `eng-platform-grafana` group. you can request it via our access app (see @accessbot below).

james: if you prefer the CLI/API route, this creates the access ticket:```bash
curl -X POST https://access.redwood.ai/api/requests -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
 -d '{"resource":"grafana","permission":"observability:view","user":"maria","reason":"sync with EU product team"}'
```That will auto-assign to platform-oncall for approval.

leo: if a model tile looks empty, try running a quick Loki query in Explore to verify data ingestion:
```loki
{job="model-serving", region="eu-west"} |= "KVCache miss" |= "latency" | json
```
That shows recent tail logs for the model-serving pods. also the model-health panels are tagged `model-health` in the dashboard list.

sre-oncall: fwiw i've temporarily relaxed the eu-west p95 alert from 800ms -> 1.2s for 24h while infra rolls a kernel patch. if you need elevated access to private cluster logs for debugging, DM me the justification and i'll add an exception. :wrench:

accessbot: Access Request created: #AR-2942 — resource: grafana, permission: observability:view, requester: maria. Approver: @platform-oncall (ETA ~3h). To speed it up, edit request and add justification: 'product sync + incident review'.

maria: thanks all! trying the links now. leo — can you pin those shortlinks to the EU runbook page? i'll wait on #AR-2942 and will DM @sre-oncall if anything blocks the sync. :thumbsup:
